events.title: Tiffany Austin- "Miles, Mingus and Monk!
events.description: A night of bebop adventures through the legendary music of Miles Davis, Thelonious Monk and Charles Mingus! Featuring: Adam Shulman Kevin Goldberg Lorca Hart Tiffany Austin is a vocalist, composer, educator, and Berkeley Law Juris Doctor.
